title: PRIOS
description: This dataset contains Cortico-Cortical Evoked Potentials (CCEPs) recorded with electrocorticography (ECoG) in 6 patients aged 13-53 years during single pulse electrical stimulation (SPES). Recordings were made in the awake state for clinical routine (SPES-clinical) and under general propofol anesthesia (SPES-propofol). The data support investigation of the effect of propofol on local effective brain networks. Electrode positions are provided in MNI305 space.
methods_description: CCEPs were recorded with ECoG during single pulse electrical stimulation, in awake patients for clinical routine and under propofol anesthesia in the operating room. Electrode positions were estimated by running FreeSurfer on each subject's MRI and converted to MNI305 space using the FreeSurfer surface-based non-linear transformation.
